access_summary: T-DXd is the current therapy and is on-label for this patient under the tumor-agnostic HER2 IHC 3+ approval, so access is not the problem. The live questions are whether to keep giving it: the 2026-08 repeat HER2 IHC has to reconcile the discordant weak MXIF signal, the severe nausea and bloating after dose 2 need a management plan or a stop decision, and the conflicting 2026-03 chest CT read has to be resolved because drug-related ILD is the toxicity that kills patients on this drug.
regulatory_status: FDA-approved, tumor-agnostic for unresectable/metastatic HER2-positive (IHC 3+) solid tumors after prior systemic therapy (accelerated approval 2024); multiple full approvals in breast and gastric cancer
guideline_status: NCCN lists T-DXd for HER2-overexpressing urothelial carcinoma post-platinum/post-EV settings per the tumor-agnostic approval

trials.title: A Phase 2 Study of T-DXd in Patients With Selected HER2 Expressing Tumors
trials.notes: DESTINY-PanTumor02, the study behind the tumor-agnostic approval and the 61.3% ORR figure in IHC 3+ disease. Enrollment is closed; the row is here as the evidence anchor, not a pathway.
trials.indication: HER2-expressing solid tumors including a bladder cohort

manufacturer.notes: US medical information line, Monday-Friday 9am-6pm ET.

payer_access_notes: Covered on-label under the tumor-agnostic approval when current IHC 3+ documentation is in the chart; a downgrade to HER2-low on the repeat stain would move continued use off-label and invite prior-authorization pushback.
next_steps: Retrieve the 2026-08 repeat validated HER2 IHC tier; it decides continue versus stop.
Get a dedicated chest CT or pulmonology read to reconcile the 2026-03 versus 2026-06 ILD discrepancy before the next dose.
If continuing, set an antiemetic plan (olanzapine-based) and a dose-reduction threshold for the GI toxicity.
Use the next Signatera and NeXT Personal draws as the response arbiter given the post-SBRT measurable-disease ambiguity.

access_summary: Every cohort of the US registration trial is closed to this patient: prior HER2-directed therapy (T-DXd), prior MMAE ADC (enfortumab vedotin), and baseline grade 2+ neuropathy are each disqualifying, and cohorts A and B also require a prior platinum line he never had. The drug is approved only in China, so there is no US off-label route either. Logged as closed so nobody spends time on it.
regulatory_status: NMPA-approved (China) for HER2-overexpressing urothelial and gastric cancer; investigational in the US (no FDA approval)

trials.title: A Study of Disitamab Vedotin Alone or With Pembrolizumab in Urothelial Cancer That Expresses HER2
trials.notes: Prior HER2-directed therapy, prior MMAE-based ADC, and grade 2+ baseline neuropathy are each exclusionary here; the platinum-required cohorts add a fourth bar. Verified recruiting with 221 sites, but none of that helps this patient.

manufacturer.notes: Pfizer clinical-trials call center, as published on the registry record.

next_steps: No action; revisit only if a next-generation disitamab protocol without the prior-HER2/prior-MMAE exclusions opens.
geographic_scope: Approved and prescribable in mainland China only; US access is trial-only and the trial excludes this patient

access_summary: Zanidatamab is FDA-approved for HER2 IHC 3+ biliary tract cancer, so a treating oncologist can prescribe it off-label for HER2 3+ urothelial carcinoma; that is the realistic path, because the pan-tumor trial cohort that fits this histology bars prior HER2-directed therapy and current T-DXd forecloses it. Off-label use stands or falls on the pending repeat HER2 IHC: the label population is IHC 3+, and a downgrade would gut both the payer case and the biology case.
regulatory_status: FDA accelerated approval (2024-11) for previously treated HER2-positive (IHC 3+) biliary tract cancer; investigational in urothelial carcinoma

trials.title: A Phase 2 Study of Zanidatamab in Patients With HER2-expressing Tumors
trials.notes: Cohort 1 is a pan-tumor IHC 3+ basket that names urothelial carcinoma but excludes prior HER2-targeted therapy; T-DXd exposure closes it. Central IHC 3+ confirmation would be required regardless.

manufacturer.notes: JazzCares line, Monday-Friday 8am-8pm ET.

payer_access_notes: Off-label use in a non-biliary tumor will need prior authorization with the IHC 3+ documentation attached; JazzCares handles coverage casework.
next_steps: Wait for the 2026-08 repeat HER2 IHC tier; only a confirmed 3+ supports this row.
If 3+, have the treating oncologist call JazzCares (1-833-533-5299) about off-label access and patient assistance.
Position zanidatamab as a post-T-DXd HER2 option rather than a competitor to it; sequencing evidence in that direction exists in breast and gastric cohorts.

access_summary: The TAPUR basket is the most enrollable trial in this dossier: pragmatic entry criteria, ECOG 0-2, sites across Connecticut and Maine among 181 locations, and a HER2 arm keyed to ERBB2 amplification or overexpression. Whether this patient's arm is open turns on the pending full NGS report, since the 2023 panel counted copy-number alterations without naming them. Both antibodies are approved with cheap biosimilars, so plain off-label use is also on the table, with modest expected activity in a T-DXd-exposed tumor.
regulatory_status: Both FDA-approved (breast, gastric for trastuzumab); off-label in urothelial carcinoma
guideline_status: Off-guideline for urothelial carcinoma; TAPUR provides the protocolized route

trials.title: TAPUR: Testing the Use of Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Approved Drugs That Target a Specific Abnormality in a Tumor Gene in People With Advanced Stage Cancer
trials.notes: HER2 arm requires ERBB2 amplification or overexpression on a qualifying genomic report; the pending NGS retrieval decides this. ECOG 0-2 and broad community sites keep the bar low. Verified recruiting.
trials.indication: Advanced solid tumors matched to approved targeted agents (TAPUR)

manufacturer.notes: TAPUR supplies drug on-protocol, which sidesteps the off-label payer problem entirely.

payer_access_notes: Enrollment through TAPUR removes drug cost; off-label biosimilar trastuzumab outside the trial is the cheapest HER2 option but still needs prior authorization.
next_steps: Retrieve the full tissue NGS report and check for ERBB2 amplification.
Email tapur@asco.org to confirm the HER2 arm is open and which Northeast site is enrolling.
Treat this as the low-toxicity HER2 fallback; it has no cytotoxic payload and no neuropathy or ILD liability.

access_summary: Both drugs are approved and any oncologist can give the combination off-label tomorrow, but the paclitaxel half runs straight into the established grade 2 CIPN from 25 months of enfortumab vedotin, and the case file treats severe neuropathy as a veto. Accessible, not advisable; the trastuzumab-pertuzumab row covers the same axis without a neurotoxic partner.
regulatory_status: Both components FDA-approved; combination off-label for urothelial carcinoma
payer_access_notes: Generic paclitaxel and biosimilar trastuzumab make this the least expensive HER2 combination if it were ever wanted.
next_steps: Hold this row unless the CIPN resolves to grade 1 and the chemotherapy-free options are exhausted.
notes: Included because the researcher file carries a supporting study; the neuropathy veto is the operative fact.

access_summary: An allogeneic HER2 CAR-T with no apheresis and no manufacturing wait, enrolling on HER2 expression rather than histology, with Yale, MSK and Jefferson among the sites and no exclusion for prior HER2-directed therapy. The gates are the pending contemporary HER2 tier and the trial's own exclusion of prior cell therapy, which this patient clears as long as the TIL and NK programs stay in the discussion stage. One of the few HER2 doors T-DXd exposure does not close.

trials.title: FT825/ONO-8250, an Off-the-Shelf, HER2 CAR-T, With or Without Monoclonal Antibodies in Advanced Solid Tumors
trials.notes: HER2-expressing solid tumors; prior HER2 therapy permitted, prior cell or gene therapy excluded. Verified recruiting; Yale New Haven, MSK and Jefferson are the Northeast sites. Washout from T-DXd and the contemporary HER2 stain are the screening items.

manufacturer.notes: Contact block copied from the registry record.

next_steps: Send the trial contact the HER2 history and the 2026-08 re-stain when it lands; ask which dose cohort is open.
Confirm the mRNA neoantigen vaccine series does not count against the prior-gene-therapy exclusion before screening.
Sequence this after the T-DXd stop decision; no washout conversation is possible while dosing continues.

intervention_label: CAdVEC oncolytic adenovirus plus autologous HER2 CAR virus-specific T cells
access_summary: The HER2 bar is IHC 2+ rather than 3+, which keeps this reachable even if the repeat stain downgrades, and bladder cancer is named in the basket. The practical constraints are anatomical and geographic: a lesion must be accessible for intratumoral injection, which a single post-SBRT retroperitoneal node makes awkward, and Houston is the only site.

trials.title: Binary Oncolytic Adenovirus in Combination With HER2-Specific Autologous CAR VST, Advanced HER2 Positive Solid Tumors
trials.notes: Verified recruiting, single site at Baylor in Houston. Intratumoral delivery needs an injectable lesion; whether the para-aortic node qualifies after SBRT is an interventional-radiology question before it is an eligibility question.
trials.indication: HER2-positive solid tumors including bladder cancer

next_steps: Ask the Baylor team whether a post-SBRT para-aortic node is injectable on their protocol before anything else.
Keep as the HER2 fallback that survives a 2+ downgrade.
geographic_scope: Single US site (Houston, Texas); patient travels for care, so distance is a burden rather than a bar

access_summary: Cohort B2 of NEXUS-01 is written for exactly this history: urothelial carcinoma, prior enfortumab vedotin required rather than excluded, and a topoisomerase payload that sidesteps the MMAE neuropathy. Early data put the post-EV response rate near 47%. Six Northeast sites including MSK, Mount Sinai, Columbia, NYU and MGH. The two screening gates are a measurable RECIST lesion after SBRT to the only known nodal site and the washout from T-DXd once a stop decision is made.

trials.title: A Study of LY4052031 in Participants With Advanced or Metastatic Urothelial Cancer or Other Solid Tumors
trials.notes: Cohort B2 requires prior EV and measurable disease; corneal keratopathy is an exclusion. Verified recruiting 2026-08 with MSK, Mount Sinai, Columbia, NYU and MGH enrolling.
trials.central_contact_name: Trial questions or participation questions: 1-877-CTLILLY (1-877-285-4559) or

manufacturer.notes: Lilly clinical-trials line (1-877-CTLILLY), as published on the registry records.

next_steps: Call the Lilly trials line or have the treating team contact the nearest site (MSK or Mount Sinai) to confirm B2 slot availability.
Get a baseline CT re-read to establish whether a measurable, non-irradiated target lesion exists after the 2026-06 SBRT.
Confirm the required washout from T-DXd; both drugs carry topoisomerase payloads and the site may also want the ILD discrepancy resolved.
Flag the sequential topoisomerase-I exposure question (deruxtecan then camptothecin) with the investigator; cross-resistance is unstudied.

access_summary: The one Nectin-4 re-targeting route that does not depend on retained uniform antigen expression or an MMAE payload: prior EV is explicitly permitted, the alpha emitter kills by crossfire, and the 64Cu imaging step answers the current-expression question that the 2026-06 Nectin-4 scan left open. Mount Sinai is an enrolling site. Gates are a measurable lesion after SBRT and a roughly 3-week washout from T-DXd.

trials.title: A Study of [225Ac]Ac-AKY-1189 in Patients With Solid Tumors
trials.notes: Prior EV permitted; the 64Cu-AKY-1189 scan gates therapeutic dosing, which doubles as a contemporary Nectin-4 expression readout. Verified recruiting; Mount Sinai, UPMC and United Theranostics (Maryland) are the Northeast-reachable sites.
trials.indication: Nectin-4-expressing solid tumors including urothelial carcinoma

manufacturer.notes: Contact block copied from the registry record.

next_steps: Email the sponsor inquiry line to ask about screening at Mount Sinai and current dose-escalation stage.
Confirm measurable disease post-SBRT with the site; nodal-only disease after radiation is the recurring gate.
Time screening against the T-DXd washout; the imaging visit can be scheduled while that clock runs.

access_summary: One agent covering both the Nectin-4 and TROP2 features, built for heterogeneous or partly lost antigen, with Fast Track in post-EV urothelial cancer and sites in New Haven, Boston and New York. The load-bearing exclusion is a history of drug-induced ILD: until the conflicting 2026-03 outside CT read is reconciled against the clean 2026-06 study, screening is at risk, and current T-DXd exposure sharpens the question.
regulatory_status: Investigational; FDA Fast Track for post-EV urothelial carcinoma

trials.title: BEACON-1: Study of AVZO-103 as a Single Agent and in Combination Therapy in Patients With Locally Advanced or Metastatic Urothelial Cancer or Other Solid Tumors (AVZO-103-1001)
trials.notes: Verified recruiting; New Haven, Boston and New York sites. History of drug-induced ILD is exclusionary, so the chest CT discrepancy has to be reconciled in the chart before screening. Exatecan payload avoids the MMAE neuropathy problem.
trials.indication: Advanced solid tumors including post-EV urothelial carcinoma

manufacturer.notes: Contact block copied from the registry record.

next_steps: Get a pulmonology adjudication of the 2026-03 versus 2026-06 chest CT reads documented in the chart first.
Contact the sponsor about the New Haven or New York site and the current escalation cohort.
Plan around the T-DXd washout and the measurable-disease re-read, same as the other post-EV ADC options.

access_summary: Three exclusions converge on this patient: grade 2 or worse baseline neuropathy, ILD or pneumonitis within 6 months, and a history of other solid tumors, which the 2020 prostate primary may trigger. The lower free-MMAE design is meant to spare nerves, but it is still MMAE in a patient with established CIPN. Reachable only if formal neuropathy grading comes back below 2 and the ILD read resolves clean.

trials.title: A Phase 1/2 Study to Investigate CRB-701 in Solid Tumors
trials.notes: Yale and Dana-Farber are the nearby sites. Grade 2+ neuropathy, recent ILD/pneumonitis and second-malignancy history are the posted exclusions that bite; verified recruiting.

manufacturer.notes: Contact block copied from the registry record.

next_steps: Only pursue if a formal CIPN assessment grades below 2; otherwise the MMAE rows stay closed.
Ask the sponsor whether a remote, definitively treated prostate primary triggers the second-malignancy exclusion.

access_summary: Entry asks only for an advanced solid tumor that progressed on or could not tolerate standard therapy, with no posted Nectin-4 cutoff and no prior-ADC exclusion, which makes it one of the few Nectin-4 protocols a post-EV patient can approach without a waiver. The registry does not name the payload; if it is MMAE the neuropathy veto applies. US sites are Arizona and Virginia only.

trials.title: A Trial to Investigate the Safety of E303 in Participants With Advanced Refractory Solid Tumors
trials.notes: Verified recruiting; the only Northeast-adjacent site is Fairfax, Virginia. Payload undisclosed in the registry record; ask before screening.

manufacturer.notes: Contact block copied from the registry record; the listed line is the Korean headquarters.

next_steps: Email the sponsor to ask what the payload is; that answer decides whether this row is live.
If non-MMAE, ask the Fairfax site about slots and the washout requirement.

access_summary: A Nectin-4 bispecific with no cytotoxic payload at all, which is the cleanest way around the MMAE neuropathy problem, and urothelial cancer is one of three enrolling histologies with ECOG up to 2. It runs only in Australia. The patient's demonstrated willingness to travel internationally keeps it on the list, but enrollment abroad means months on site, and the posted criteria leave the Nectin-4 cutoff and prior-ADC rules unstated.

trials.title: A Phase 1a/1b, First-Time-in-Human Study of CT-202, a Nectin-4 Directed Bispecific Antibody, in Participants With Recurring Triple Negative Breast, Colorectal, Urothelial Cancers
trials.notes: Verified recruiting at three Australian sites. No US site planned in the current record; ask the sponsor about US expansion before considering travel.

manufacturer.notes: Contact block copied from the registry record; Context is US-based even though the trial enrolls in Australia.

next_steps: Email the sponsor about US site plans; enrolling a US patient in Australia for a phase 1 is a last resort.
Ask for the Nectin-4 threshold and prior-ADC rules, which the registry leaves blank.
geographic_scope: Australia only; sponsor is US-based, so a US-site question is worth asking

access_summary: The only protocol found anywhere that explicitly allows both prior enfortumab vedotin and prior HER2-directed therapy, with a Nectin-4 bar low enough to survive partial antigen loss. It enrolls only in China and strongly prefers a fresh post-treatment biopsy, which collides with this patient's tissue scarcity. Logged so the board can see the design exists; not a practical route today.

trials.title: Dual-Target Nectin-4/HER2 CAR-NK Cells in Advanced Urothelial Carcinoma
trials.notes: Single site in China, verified recruiting. Fresh-biopsy preference and cross-border cell-therapy logistics make this informational rather than actionable.
trials.indication: Urothelial carcinoma, post-EV and post-HER2 therapy allowed

next_steps: Track for a US or ex-China site opening; no outreach warranted now.

access_summary: Nectin-4 CAR-T exists only as preclinical work; no clinical program is enrolling anywhere. The concept is on the dossier because antigen-priming data suggest a route around post-EV antigen loss, but there is nothing to call about. The Chinese dual-target CAR-NK row is the closest clinical relative.
next_steps: None; revisit if a first-in-human Nectin-4 CAR program posts.

access_summary: ETx-22 has no registry entry and no first-in-human trial; its developer Emergence Therapeutics was acquired by Eli Lilly in 2023 and the asset has not surfaced as a named clinical program. The clinically open way to get a topoisomerase payload onto Nectin-4 today is Lilly's own LY4052031, which has its own row and is enrolling.
next_steps: Pursue LY4052031 instead; it is the enrolling embodiment of the same idea.

access_summary: Preclinical only, and the surveyor already marked it considered-excluded. No clinical program, no access path, and deep nodal disease is a poor anatomical fit for a light-activated therapy in any case.
next_steps: None.

access_summary: On-label and freely prescribable in this indication, and the patient already took it for about 25 months to a complete response before neuropathy forced discontinuation. Rechallenge is a real, documented practice after toxicity interruption, but the grade 2 CIPN with an active management project makes further MMAE exposure the thing the preferences file most clearly vetoes. Access is trivial; the constraint is entirely toxicity.
regulatory_status: FDA-approved for locally advanced/metastatic urothelial carcinoma (with pembrolizumab and as monotherapy)
guideline_status: NCCN category 1 (with pembrolizumab) for first-line metastatic urothelial carcinoma

manufacturer.company: Astellas Pharma (with Pfizer/Seagen for enfortumab vedotin)
manufacturer.notes: Astellas US medical information line.

payer_access_notes: On-label; no access barrier. Astellas Pharma Support Solutions handles copay and access casework.
next_steps: Keep in reserve; rechallenge only if the CIPN resolves substantially and Nectin-4 expression is reconfirmed on contemporary tissue or imaging.
Prefer the non-MMAE Nectin-4 rows (LY4052031, AKY-1189) for re-targeting the axis.

access_summary: The urothelial accelerated approval was withdrawn in 2024 after TROPiCS-04, so in this indication the drug is trial-only, and TROPHY-U-01 cohort 2 happens to be the one registered cohort in the post-EV landscape built for a patient who never had platinum: it takes platinum-ineligible patients who progressed after first-line anti-PD-(L)1. The breast approvals still stand, so off-label prescription is technically possible, but payers will lean on the withdrawn UC indication. The team would need to document platinum ineligibility to enroll.
regulatory_status: FDA-approved in triple-negative and HR+/HER2- breast cancer; urothelial accelerated approval withdrawn 2024
guideline_status: Removed from NCCN urothelial recommendations after the withdrawal

trials.title: Study of Sacituzumab Govitecan in Participants With Urothelial Cancer That Cannot Be Removed or Has Spread
trials.notes: TROPHY-U-01 cohort 2: platinum-ineligible, post-checkpoint urothelial carcinoma. Verified recruiting with Yale-New Haven, NYU Perlmutter and Stony Brook among Northeast sites; confirm cohort 2 specifically still has slots, since cohort-level status is not in the registry record.

manufacturer.notes: Medical information line 1-833-GILEAD-0; the email is the sponsor's clinical-trials contact from the registry record.

payer_access_notes: Off-label use in urothelial carcinoma after a withdrawn indication is a hard prior-authorization case; enrollment supplies drug on-protocol and is the cleaner route.
next_steps: Have the treating team document formal platinum ineligibility (cisplatin and carboplatin criteria) in the chart.
Call the Gilead trials line to confirm cohort 2 enrollment status and the nearest open Northeast site.
Retrieve the validated 2026-08 TROP2 IHC tier; low expression does not bar entry but calibrates expectations.
Sequence against the T-DXd washout; both payloads are topoisomerase I inhibitors and the site will ask about cumulative exposure.

access_summary: The phase 3 requires prior platinum, prior anti-PD-(L)1 and prior EV, and this patient never received platinum, so the trial is closed on a line-of-therapy technicality rather than biology. The control arm is a taxane or vinflunine, which the neuropathy would veto anyway. Kept visible because the platinum gap recurs across the registered post-EV landscape and is worth a strategic conversation with the treating team.
regulatory_status: Investigational in the US (approved in China for some indications); no FDA approval

trials.title: A Clinical Trial of Sacituzumab Tirumotecan (Sac-TMT, MK-2870) to Treat Urothelial Cancer (MK-2870-031)
trials.notes: Prior platinum is a hard inclusion requirement the patient does not meet. Verified recruiting; MSK is a site, which makes it easy to ask whether any protocol amendment relaxes the platinum requirement.

manufacturer.notes: Trial-site inquiries go through the registry contact on each study record; no separate medical-information line verified this pass.

next_steps: No enrollment path as written; ask MSK whether other sac-TMT urothelial protocols without the platinum requirement are planned.
Log the strategic question: never having received platinum forecloses a growing set of trials, and whether to ever give platinum is a treatment-planning decision, not a screening one.

access_summary: Approved in breast and lung cancer, so off-label prescription for urothelial carcinoma is possible, and a urothelial substudy exists inside an AstraZeneca platform with loose line requirements. Two collisions to clear: the platform requires a measurable lesion that was not irradiated, which the SBRT-treated node may fail, and Dato-DXd carries the same deruxtecan ILD signal already at issue on T-DXd, so the unresolved chest CT read cuts against this whole payload class.
regulatory_status: FDA-approved in HR+/HER2- breast cancer and EGFR-mutated NSCLC; investigational in urothelial carcinoma

trials.title: Study of Dato-DXd as Monotherapy and in Combination With Anti-cancer Agents in Patients With Advanced Solid Tumours (TROPION-PanTumor03)
trials.notes: Urothelial substudy inside a pan-tumor platform; master criteria ask for ECOG 0-1, tissue, and one measurable unirradiated lesion. Verified recruiting; Boston and New Jersey research sites listed. The unirradiated-lesion rule and the ILD question are the screening risks.

manufacturer.notes: AstraZeneca Clinical Study Information Center, as published on the registry records.

payer_access_notes: Off-label Dato-DXd in urothelial carcinoma will face prior-authorization resistance; on-protocol supply through the substudy avoids it.
next_steps: Resolve the ILD read first; a deruxtecan-class ADC is hard to justify while a fibrosis question is open.
Ask the AstraZeneca information center whether the urothelial substudy is enrolling and whether any new measurable lesion exists outside the SBRT field.
Retrieve the validated TROP2 IHC tier for context, noting the platform does not gate on it.

access_summary: Urothelial carcinoma is a named histology with no cap on prior regimens, and prior TROP2 or topoisomerase-payload exposure is permitted, so the T-DXd history does not close it. A STING payload is a different mechanism from a cytotoxic ADC and may depend less on expression level, which suits a weak TROP2 stain. Hackensack and Long Island sites put it in easy reach; decline the enfortumab vedotin combination arms given the neuropathy.

trials.title: A Study of ASP2998 Given by Itself and Given With Standard Therapies in People With Solid Tumors
trials.notes: Verified recruiting; Hackensack (NJ), New Hyde Park (NY) and Fairfax (VA) sites. Prior TROP2/topo-I exposure allowed. Monotherapy or pembrolizumab arms are the sensible ones here; the EV arm is not.
trials.indication: Advanced solid tumors including urothelial carcinoma

manufacturer.notes: Contact block copied from the registry record; general Astellas medical information is 1-800-727-7003.

next_steps: Contact the Hackensack site about escalation-cohort openings for urothelial carcinoma.
State the arm preference (monotherapy or pembrolizumab combination, not EV) at first contact.
Standard gates apply: T-DXd washout and the measurable-disease re-read.

access_summary: Dose escalation takes any refractory solid tumor and permits prior TROP2-directed therapy, so the weak stain and the T-DXd history do not close it. The problem is protocol biopsies: mandatory pre- and on-treatment sampling in the enrichment cohorts, against a tumor with one fresh-frozen vial left and nodal cores running 5 to 10% tumor content. Dana-Farber is the nearest site.

trials.title: A Study to Evaluate TROP2 ADC LCB84 Single Agent and in Combination With an Anti-PD-1 Ab in Advanced Solid Tumors
trials.notes: Verified recruiting; Dana-Farber is the Northeast site. Ask which cohorts waive the mandatory biopsies; escalation slots sometimes do.

manufacturer.notes: Contact block copied from the registry record.

next_steps: Ask the sponsor whether an escalation slot without mandatory biopsies is open before spending a screening visit.
Prefer ASP2998 or the TROPHY-U-01 route if biopsy demands cannot be reduced; tissue is the scarcest resource in this case.

access_summary: Preclinical only and already marked considered-excluded by the surveyor; no registered trial, no access path. The clinically open TROP2 rows (ASP2998, LCB84, Dato-DXd, sacituzumab govitecan) cover the axis.
next_steps: None.

access_summary: Entry is written around mesothelin expression rather than histology, which is the only way a mesothelin-positive urothelial carcinoma gets a hearing, and Hackensack and Penn are enrolling. Everything waits on a validated mesothelin IHC, because the strong 2026-08 signal is research-grade MXIF and no protocol screens on that. An off-the-shelf antibody also avoids the manufacturing and lymphodepletion cost of the CAR-T alternatives.

trials.title: CT-95 in Advanced Cancers Associated With Mesothelin Expression
trials.notes: Verified recruiting; Hackensack (NJ) and two Philadelphia sites. Mesothelin expression entry criterion; prior mesothelin-directed therapy excluded, which does not apply. Ask about soluble mesothelin testing at the same visit.

manufacturer.notes: Contact block copied from the registry record.

next_steps: Order a validated mesothelin IHC on existing tissue first; mind the 5-10% tumor-content caveat on the nodal cores.
If positive, contact the Hackensack site and ask which escalation cohort is open and whether they accept outside IHC.
Measure soluble mesothelin at the same time; an antigen sink changes the dosing conversation.

access_summary: NCI dose escalation takes mesothelin-expressing solid tumors generally with no limit on prior regimens, and the trial runs its own mesothelin assay at screening, so a local validated stain qualifies the referral rather than deciding it. Measurable disease is required and Bethesda is the only site. The banked apheresis does not shortcut anything here since the protocol collects its own product, but this patient's logistics make an NIH referral routine.

trials.title: Anti-Mesothelin TNaive/SCM hYP218 (TNhYP218) CAR T Cells in Participants With Mesothelin-Expressing Solid Tumors Including Mesothelioma
trials.notes: Verified recruiting at the NIH Clinical Center; central contacts are the research nurse and Dr. Raffit Hassan. Measurable disease post-SBRT and one prior FDA-approved therapy (met) are the entry mechanics.

next_steps: Send pathology and the MXIF report to the NCI contacts and ask whether they will run their mesothelin assay on existing tissue.
Confirm the measurable-disease read; NIH screening will want a qualifying target lesion.
Coordinate timing with the vaccine series and any T-DXd washout.

access_summary: Entry runs only through the BASECAMP-1 screening study and the whole design depends on tumor HLA-A*02 loss of heterozygosity, which is unmeasured here but computable from the existing exome data at no tissue cost. An ILD-with-steroids history inside a year is an exclusion, so the chest CT reconciliation matters here too. Low probability, but the LOH analysis is free and settles it; NYU is a site.

trials.title: A Study to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of Mesothelin-Targeting Logic-gated CAR T, in Participants With Solid Tumors That Express MSLN and Have Lost HLA-A*02 Expression
trials.notes: Verified recruiting; NYU Langone is the Northeast site. Enrollment requires prior BASECAMP-1 banking and confirmed HLA-A*02 LOH in tumor; urothelial carcinoma is not on BASECAMP-1's named list, so an exception conversation is needed.
trials.indication: Mesothelin-expressing solid tumors with HLA-A*02 loss of heterozygosity

manufacturer.notes: Contact block copied from the registry record.

next_steps: Run the HLA-A*02 LOH computation on the banked WES data; it costs nothing and is the gating fact.
If LOH is present, ask the sponsor whether BASECAMP-1 will take an off-list histology.
Get the ILD question adjudicated; a steroid-requiring ILD history within a year excludes.

access_summary: The histology list is closed to ovarian, peritoneal, fallopian tube, cholangiocarcinoma and mesothelioma, so this patient cannot enroll. The row exists because the KIR-CAR architecture is a distinct attempt at the persistence problem that has limited mesothelin CAR-T, and Penn is local to the case's orbit if a basket ever opens.

trials.title: SynKIR-110 for Mesothelin Expressing Ovarian Cancer, Cholangiocarcinoma or Mesothelioma
trials.notes: Verified recruiting at Penn; histology list excludes urothelial carcinoma outright.
trials.indication: Mesothelioma, ovarian and biliary cancers only

next_steps: No action; watch for a histology expansion.

access_summary: The phase 1/2 stopped enrolling and the program was deprioritized after TCR2 Therapeutics folded into Adaptimmune in 2023; no successor trial is recruiting. The dossier keeps the clinical data as evidence for the mesothelin axis, but there is no way to receive gavo-cel today.
regulatory_status: Investigational; development deprioritized after the 2023 TCR2/Adaptimmune merger

trials.title: Phase 1/2 Trial of Gavo-cel (TC-210) in Patients With Advanced Mesothelin-Expressing Cancer
trials.notes: Verified active-not-recruiting with no central contact posted; no successor study registered.

next_steps: None; the open mesothelin cell-therapy doors are TNhYP218 and, conditionally, A2B694.

intervention_label: huCART-meso (fully human anti-mesothelin CAR T cells)
access_summary: The Penn huCART-meso program has no recruiting study: the monotherapy trials completed or terminated and the remaining combination study is active-not-recruiting in pancreatic and ovarian cancer. The clinical experience stays in the dossier as evidence; enrollment is not possible. TNhYP218 at the NCI is the enrolling mesothelin CAR-T alternative.
regulatory_status: Investigational; academic program with no recruiting protocol
next_steps: None; route mesothelin cell-therapy interest to the TNhYP218 row.

access_summary: Bayer stopped developing anetumab ravtansine after the phase 2 mesothelioma failure; remaining NCI combination studies are active-not-recruiting and no new enrollment exists. A DM4 payload would also have run into the neuropathy veto. The row closes the loop so the mesothelin-ADC question does not linger.
next_steps: None.

access_summary: Preclinical constructs with no registered trial, and MMAE payloads would face the neuropathy veto in any case. No access path.
next_steps: None.

access_summary: The one enrolling clinical route onto MUC1: a Daiichi Sankyo first-in-human ADC against tumor-associated MUC1 with a DXd payload, verified recruiting with Rhode Island Hospital as the nearest US site. Urothelial fit and the TA-MUC1 threshold need direct sponsor confirmation, the strong MXIF signal still needs a validated stain, and the DXd payload drags the ILD question along with it.

trials.title: First-in-Human Study of DS-3939a in Participants With Advanced Solid Tumors
trials.notes: Verified recruiting 2026-08; US sites include Rhode Island Hospital (Providence). Measurable disease and ECOG 0-1 required. A follow-on study (NCT07739966) is posted but not yet recruiting. TA-MUC1 screening assay and histology openings need sponsor confirmation.
trials.central_contact_name: (US Sites) Daiichi Sankyo Contact for Clinical Trial Information

manufacturer.notes: US medical information line, Monday-Friday 9am-6pm ET.

next_steps: Email CTRinfo@dsi.com to ask whether urothelial carcinoma can screen and what MUC1 assay gates entry.
Get a validated MUC1 IHC (clone matched to the trial assay) before committing tissue.
Weigh the DXd payload against the unresolved ILD read; same class as T-DXd.
notes: This trial is not in trials.jsonl; it was found during the access pass as the enrolling study for the surveyed TA-MUC1 ADC. Flagged for a trial_screener re-run rather than added to that file.

access_summary: The deciding exclusion is procedural: the most recent systemic therapy cannot have been a topoisomerase-I-payload ADC, which is exactly what T-DXd is, so the door only opens after an intervening regimen. A known ILD history is also excluded. MUC1 remains a research-grade signal without a validated stain, so this row is parked behind both a sequencing problem and an assay problem.

trials.title: A Study of NEOK002, an EGFR and MUC1 Targeting Bispecific ADC, in Participants With Select Solid Tumors
trials.notes: Verified recruiting; MSK is a site. Ineligible while T-DXd is the most recent systemic therapy; re-check after any intervening regimen, along with the ILD adjudication.

manufacturer.notes: Contact block copied from the registry record.

next_steps: Park until an intervening non-topo-I regimen exists; then revisit with a validated MUC1 stain and the ILD read.

access_summary: Not yet open, Australia only, and the registry does not say what the construct is or which MUC1 epitope it hits, which matters because normal epithelium carries wild-type MUC1. Track rather than pursue.

trials.title: Evaluation of XYA02 in Patients With Advanced Solid Tumors
trials.notes: Verified not yet recruiting; five Australian sites planned. Construct and epitope undisclosed.

next_steps: Track for opening and for construct disclosure; no outreach warranted now.

access_summary: All gatipotuzumab studies completed years ago and no active development program is registered; the naked-antibody approach did not advance past phase 2. The evidence stays as mechanism support for the TA-MUC1 axis, whose live embodiment is DS-3939a.
next_steps: None; pursue the DS-3939a row instead.

access_summary: The single phase 1 record has unknown status and has not been updated in years; no active program exists. No access path.
next_steps: None.

intervention_label: MUC1-C inhibition (GO-203 class, preclinical for this use)
access_summary: Marked considered-excluded upstream and with no enrolling solid-tumor program, MUC1-C inhibitors have no access path for this case.
next_steps: None.

access_summary: The patient already clears the HLA-A*02:01 gate and MGH, MSK, Penn and three other Northeast sites are enrolling, with a rare-cancer extension cohort giving urothelial carcinoma a route in. The open question is PRAME expression: the trial screens with its own RT-qPCR assay, so the 2026-08 PRAME imaging read informs but does not substitute. Banked apheresis shortens the manufacturing runway if screening succeeds.

trials.title: ACTengine® IMA203/IMA203CD8 as Monotherapy or in Combination With Nivolumab in Recurrent and/or Refractory Solid Tumors
trials.notes: Verified recruiting; the sponsor's RT-qPCR PRAME screen on tumor tissue is the gate, and measurable disease is required. Tissue scarcity makes the screening-biopsy conversation important up front.

manufacturer.notes: Contact block copied from the registry record.

next_steps: Retrieve the 2026-08 PRAME imaging read; if it suggests expression, contact Immatics about rare-cancer cohort screening.
Ask whether the sponsor's PRAME RT-qPCR can run on existing banked tissue given the 5-10% tumor-content caveat.
Confirm measurable disease and cell-therapy sequencing against the ongoing vaccine series.

access_summary: Eligibility is exactly this patient's pair of gates, HLA-A*02:01 plus PRAME positivity, with no histology restriction, but the trial runs only in Australia, France, Italy and Spain. The patient's demonstrated willingness to travel keeps it listed, and Immunocore's medical information line is the right place to ask about US site plans.

trials.title: Study of IMC-P115C in Advanced PRAME-Positive Cancers
trials.notes: Verified recruiting; no US sites. An off-the-shelf biologic needs repeat dosing on site, so enrollment abroad means sustained residence, unlike a one-time cell infusion.

manufacturer.notes: Global medical information contact, as published on the registry record.

next_steps: Ask Immunocore medical information whether a US site is planned and whether tebentafusp-style expanded access is contemplated for PRAME.
Settle PRAME expression locally first; without it the travel question is moot.
geographic_scope: Australia and EU only; no US site in the current record

access_summary: The parent phase 1/2 stopped enrolling and the only new brenetafusp study is an NCI sarcoma protocol that has not opened and would not take urothelial carcinoma anyway. Nothing to enroll in today; the class's open doors for this patient are IMA203 and, geography permitting, IMC-P115C. If PRAME comes back strongly positive, a compassionate-use conversation with Immunocore is the remaining brenetafusp route.

trials.title: Safety and Efficacy of IMC-F106C as a Single Agent and in Combination With Checkpoint Inhibitors
trials.notes: Parent study, verified active-not-recruiting; evidence anchor for the class.

trials.title: Testing the Anti-Cancer Drug, Brenetafusp (IMCF106C), in Rare Cancers
trials.notes: Verified not yet recruiting; synovial sarcoma and myxoid/round-cell liposarcoma only. Useful precedent for PRAME-high selection outside melanoma.

manufacturer.notes: Global medical information contact, as published on the registry record.

next_steps: If PRAME confirms positive, ask Immunocore medical information about expanded access to brenetafusp for an HLA-matched, PRAME-positive off-melanoma patient.
Otherwise route PRAME interest through the IMA203 row.

intervention_label: CLSP-1025 (TP53 R175H x HLA-A*02:01 T-cell engager)
access_summary: Both molecular gates are already answered in the record: HLA-A*02:01 on 2025-01 typing and TP53 R175H on 2025-06 plasma. An off-the-shelf engager needs no manufacturing slot, four of the sites (NYU, MSK, Hackensack, Johns Hopkins) sit inside the patient's care orbit, and histology is open. The honest caveat is that the R175H call rests on a single 0.09% VAF plasma read, so the sponsor's central confirmation is the real gate and a tissue-level check would firm the case first.

trials.title: A Study of CLSP-1025 in Adult Patients With Solid Tumors That Harbor the p53 R175H Mutation
trials.notes: Verified recruiting; central contact is the sponsor's medical lead. The prostate primary fits the remission carve-out. Bring the Guardant360 report and the tissue NGS showing TP53 mutation to the first call.

manufacturer.notes: Contact block copied from the registry record.

next_steps: Confirm R175H in tissue: check whether the 2023 NGS panel's TP53 call specifies R175H before relying on the 0.09% plasma read.
Contact the sponsor about screening at NYU or MSK and ask what specimen their central mutation confirmation needs.
Time screening against the T-DXd washout; an engager protocol will want prior-therapy resolution.

access_summary: The histology list ends in any other solid tumor, so entry rides on the two molecular gates the patient meets on paper, and banked apheresis shortens the manufacturing runway. Prior adoptive cell or gene therapy is excluded, which currently reads clean but makes the ongoing mRNA vaccine series something to disclose rather than assume benign. Boston, New Brunswick, New York and Pittsburgh sites; AstraZeneca runs the program through Neogene.

trials.title: A Study of NT-175 in Adult Participants With Advanced Malignancies That Are Positive for HLA-A*02:01 and the TP53 R175H Mutation
trials.notes: Verified recruiting; same molecular gates as CLSP-1025 plus lymphodepletion tolerance. The three-year second-primary exclusion clears the 2020 prostate cancer.

manufacturer.notes: AstraZeneca Clinical Study Information Center, as published on the registry records.

next_steps: Call the AstraZeneca study information center to ask about slot and manufacturing timelines at the New York or Boston site.
Disclose the vaccine series and confirm it does not trip the gene-therapy exclusion.
Run the same tissue-level R175H confirmation as the CLSP-1025 row; one confirmation serves both.
Compare timelines: the engager (CLSP-1025) doses off the shelf while this needs manufacture; sequencing one after the other is worth asking both sponsors about.

intervention_label: neoantigen-selected TIL with aldesleukin (NCI Surgery Branch)
access_summary: Genitourinary tumors are named and the selection principle matches the neoantigen program this patient is already running, with 24 predicted neoepitopes and serial PBMCs banked. The binding constraint is surgical: TIL generation needs a lesion resectable with minimal morbidity, and the only known disease is a post-SBRT para-aortic node. High-dose aldesleukin tolerance is the other conversation. The family's NCI referral costs one phone call to the same Bethesda center as the TNhYP218 row.

trials.title: Immunotherapy Using Tumor Infiltrating Lymphocytes for Patients With Metastatic Cancer
trials.notes: Verified recruiting at the NIH Clinical Center. Resectable-lesion requirement is the gate; ask whether a radiated node or a future new lesion serves, and whether their pipeline can leverage the banked material.

next_steps: Call the Surgery Branch recruitment line with imaging and ask whether any current or anticipated lesion supports TIL harvest.
Offer the banked fresh-frozen tumor vial and serial PBMCs; the branch decides what it can use.
Revisit at the next progression event; a new unirradiated lesion changes this from marginal to live.

access_summary: The patient is already receiving this class through two investigational programs, with the mRNA series ongoing and the next EliSpot the decision point, so access is not the question. No registered vaccine trial adds anything: the one in the dossier is triple-negative breast only. The practical access work is keeping the current programs supplied and pairing the vaccine question with the checkpoint-intensification decision the board is weighing.
regulatory_status: Investigational; administered under the programs' own protocols

trials.title: Testing the Addition of an Individualized Vaccine to Durvalumab and Tremelimumab and Chemotherapy in Patients With Metastatic Triple Negative Breast Cancer
trials.notes: Triple-negative breast cancer only; in the dossier as the design precedent for vaccine plus CTLA-4/PD-L1 intensification, not as an option.

next_steps: Complete the 2026-09 mRNA dose and the post-series EliSpot; that readout drives the whole vaccine/ACT branch.
If immunogenicity stays CD4-skewed and modest, redirect energy to the TIL and TCR rows rather than a third vaccine program.

access_summary: On-label twice over (urothelial carcinoma and the TMB>=10 tumor-agnostic approval) and the patient has been on it for years, so there is nothing to obtain. Progression occurred on pembrolizumab maintenance, which is why re-challenge alone is weakly supported and the live question is intensification on top of it, handled in the nivolumab-ipilimumab and N-803 rows. Currently on hold since 2026-07.
regulatory_status: FDA-approved for urothelial carcinoma and tumor-agnostic TMB-H (>=10 mut/Mb)

manufacturer.notes: Trial-site inquiries go through the registry contact on each study record; no separate medical-information line verified this pass.

payer_access_notes: On-label; no access barrier. The cross-assay TMB caveat (institutional panel versus FoundationOne CDx) matters for documentation if the TMB-H label is the coverage basis.
next_steps: Keep the hold/restart decision tied to the next therapy choice; several trial rows allow pembrolizumab combination arms.

access_summary: Both antibodies are approved and the doublet is prescribable off-label now, which is what the care team is already exploring; payer friction and the 2025 pancreatitis history are the constraints, not supply. The registered route is the ICONIC/Alliance trial with cabozantinib, whose variant-histology cohorts want roughly 50% plasmacytoid or giant-cell composition that this tumor's focal pattern may not meet without a central re-read. Off-label dosing lets the team pick the gentler ipilimumab schedule the boost data support.
regulatory_status: Both FDA-approved (multiple indications); the doublet is off-label in urothelial carcinoma
guideline_status: Off-guideline for urothelial carcinoma; NCCN does not currently list the doublet in this setting

trials.title: Testing the Effectiveness of Two Immunotherapy Drugs (Nivolumab and Ipilimumab) With One Anti-cancer Targeted Drug (Cabozantinib) for Rare Genitourinary Tumors
trials.notes: ICONIC: cabozantinib plus nivolumab plus ipilimumab in rare genitourinary variants; verified recruiting with 581 sites, no central contact posted (site-level contact through the registry page). Variant-percentage requirement is the eligibility question for this focally variant tumor.
trials.indication: Rare genitourinary tumors including plasmacytoid and giant-cell urothelial variants

manufacturer.notes: BMS Access Support line (coverage and access, Monday-Friday 8am-8pm ET); route clinical questions through the prescriber portal at bmsmedinfo.com.

payer_access_notes: Off-label nivo/ipi in urothelial carcinoma needs prior authorization with the TMB and prior-response narrative attached; BMS Access Support (1-800-861-0048) runs coverage casework, and the trial route supplies drug on-protocol if a variant cohort fits.
next_steps: Get an expert pathology re-read quantifying plasmacytoid and giant-cell percentages; it decides trial versus off-label.
If off-label, agree on a pancreatitis surveillance plan up front given the 2025 episode; lipase monitoring is already q3-4wk.
File prior authorization with the TMB 12.4, the deep 1L response and the progression-on-maintenance story.

access_summary: Approved for BCG-unresponsive non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer, so off-label systemic use in metastatic disease is prescribable, and ImmunityBio operates expanded-access machinery including an FDA-authorized ANKTIVA protocol and a posted compassionate-use page. The single-patient IND the care team is already discussing for NK cells plus N-803 is the same pathway this row supports; the QUILT trial that tested the exact concept closed accrual, so no enrollment route exists.
regulatory_status: FDA-approved (2024) with BCG for BCG-unresponsive NMIBC with CIS; off-label in metastatic urothelial carcinoma; FDA-authorized expanded-access protocol exists for a lymphopenia indication
guideline_status: NCCN-listed for BCG-unresponsive NMIBC; off-guideline for metastatic disease

trials.title: QUILT-3.055: A Study of Combination Immunotherapies in Patients Who Have Previously Received Treatment With Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors
trials.notes: QUILT-3.055, the checkpoint-rescue study behind the concept; verified active-not-recruiting, so it supports the rationale rather than offering a slot.

manufacturer.notes: 1-877-ANKTIVA reaches Medical Affairs; the company posts an expanded-access page and has an FDA-authorized ANKTIVA expanded-access protocol (lymphopenia indication).

payer_access_notes: Off-label systemic use in metastatic disease is an uphill coverage case; the single-patient IND route with sponsor-supplied drug avoids the payer entirely if ImmunityBio agrees.
next_steps: Have the treating physician call ImmunityBio Medical Affairs (1-877-265-8482) to formalize the single-patient IND with drug supply.
Reference the posted expanded-access page and the existing FDA EAP as precedent in the request.
Coordinate with the PD-1 hold decision; the QUILT design paired N-803 with continued checkpoint blockade.

access_summary: LuMIERE selects on FAP-2286 PET uptake rather than histology, which is the right gate for a stromal target, and Columbia, MSK and UPMC are enrolling. The problem is that the only FAP scan on record argued the other way: avidity in BCG-granulomatous prostate tissue and none in the urothelial disease, with post-SBRT fibroblast activation now muddying any repeat. Retrieve the 2026-06 FAP imaging read before spending a screening slot. The Lilly FiREBOLT study accepts imaging evidence of FAP but its histology list excludes urothelial carcinoma.

trials.title: A Study of 177Lu-FAP-2286 in Advanced Solid Tumors
trials.notes: Verified recruiting; the 68Ga-FAP-2286 PET gate doubles as the diagnostic answer this axis needs. Columbia, MSK and UPMC are the Northeast sites.

trials.title: A Study of LY4337713 in Participants With FAP-Positive Solid Tumors
trials.notes: FiREBOLT (LY4337713): verified recruiting with MGH and MSK among sites, but the histology list stops short of urothelial carcinoma; a sponsor conversation about expansion is the only route.
trials.central_contact_name: Trial questions or participation questions: 1-877-CTLILLY (1-877-285-4559) or

manufacturer.notes: Sponsor contact as published on the LuMIERE registry record.

next_steps: Retrieve the 2026-06 repeat FAP imaging read; it decides whether this axis is real.
If FAP-avid disease is shown, ask the Columbia or MSK LuMIERE team to screen with a 68Ga-FAP-2286 PET.
Treat granulomatous inflammation and post-SBRT change as expected false-positive sources in any read.

access_summary: Part A1 takes any refractory advanced solid tumor, so the ARID1A hypothesis can be tested without a selected cohort, and Northwell, Penn and Jefferson are among the sites. The honest framing: the expansion cohorts select for ATM loss or HRD rather than ARID1A, the synthetic-lethality argument is preclinical, and archival tissue is required against a scarce-tissue case. The pending NGS retrieval could upgrade this row if a homologous-recombination finding surfaces.

trials.title: A Study of ART0380 for the Treatment of Advanced or Metastatic Solid Tumors
trials.notes: Verified recruiting through Sarah Cannon; ask whether A1 slots are open and how much archival tissue submission actually requires.

manufacturer.notes: Contact block copied from the registry record (Sarah Cannon runs trial operations).

next_steps: Retrieve the full NGS report first; an HRD or ATM finding changes which cohort applies.
Ask the Sarah Cannon line about A1 availability and the archival-tissue minimum.
Rank behind the antigen-directed rows; the mechanistic case is hypothesis-grade.

access_summary: Ceralasertib remains investigational and none of its recruiting studies fit: the active combinations run in lung cancer, melanoma and gynecologic cohorts, and the ARID1A-relevant academic studies have closed. The dossier's ceralasertib evidence supports the ATR hypothesis, but the enrollable embodiment of that hypothesis for this patient is ART0380's all-comers arm, not this drug.

manufacturer.notes: AstraZeneca Clinical Study Information Center, as published on the registry records.

next_steps: Route ATR-axis interest through the ART0380 row; no ceralasertib protocol currently fits this case.

access_summary: No berzosertib study is recruiting; the NCI combinations are active-not-recruiting and the sponsor deprioritized the program after the 2023-24 readouts. The evidence stays as mechanism support for the ATR axis; there is no way to receive the drug.
regulatory_status: Investigational; sponsor development deprioritized, no recruiting trial
next_steps: None; the ATR door is ART0380.

access_summary: The one trial that selects on ARID1A loss of function pairs tuvusertib with avelumab, but it enrolls endometrial cancer only, so this patient cannot join. It stays in the file as the reference point for how the ARID1A-ATR-plus-checkpoint idea is being tested, and as the design the immune-intensification branch here most resembles.
regulatory_status: Tuvusertib investigational; avelumab FDA-approved (urothelial maintenance among others)

trials.title: Avelumab and M1774 in ARID1A-mutated Endometrial Cancer
trials.notes: Verified recruiting at Dana-Farber and Brigham; endometrial histology requirement excludes. The PI contact is posted if the team wants to ask about basket plans.

next_steps: Ask the DFCI investigator whether an ARID1A basket or urothelial arm is planned; otherwise no action.

intervention_label: PARP inhibition (with temozolomide) for ARID1A-mutant disease
access_summary: PARP inhibitors are approved drugs, so off-label prescription is mechanically possible, but the ARID1A rationale is preclinical, urothelial carcinoma is outside every PARP label, and no germline or somatic HRR finding currently supports it. Coverage would be a fight and the biology does not yet earn one. The pending NGS retrieval is the only thing that could move this row.
regulatory_status: Class FDA-approved in BRCA/HRR-selected indications; off-label and biomarker-unsupported here
payer_access_notes: Expect denial without an HRR biomarker; no PARP label covers urothelial carcinoma.
next_steps: Hold unless the full NGS report reveals an HRR alteration; then reassess against TAPUR-style basket options.

access_summary: Tazemetostat is approved in epithelioid sarcoma and follicular lymphoma, so off-label use is possible on paper, but the dedicated ARID1A-mutant solid-tumor study was terminated and the rationale for this case remains preclinical. Logged as a closed loop rather than a live option.
regulatory_status: FDA-approved (epithelioid sarcoma, follicular lymphoma); off-label and hypothesis-grade here
payer_access_notes: Off-label coverage unlikely without trial-level evidence; the ARID1A basket that would have generated it (NCT05023655) was terminated.
next_steps: No action; revisit only if new ARID1A-EZH2 clinical data emerge.

access_summary: Cohort B7 pairs a qualifying FGFR3 alteration with HER2 expression, the one place in the registry where this patient's HER2 result and his unread FGFR3 status intersect. Everything rides on the sequencing retrieval: FGFR3 is unknown in the derived record and roughly 15 to 20% of metastatic urothelial carcinoma qualifies. Eight-plus Northeast sites including MSK, NYU, Cornell, Columbia and MGH make this instantly actionable if the report shows an alteration.

trials.title: FORAGER-1: A Study of Vepugratinib (LY3866288; LOXO-435) in Participants With Cancer With a Change in a Gene Called FGFR3
trials.notes: Verified recruiting; eligibility is conditional on an FGFR3 alteration nobody has looked for yet. Avoid the T-DXd combination arms given the ILD question.
trials.central_contact_name: Trial questions or participation questions: 1-877-CTLILLY (1-877-285-4559) or

manufacturer.notes: Lilly clinical-trials line (1-877-CTLILLY), as published on the registry records.

next_steps: Retrieve the full tissue NGS report and read out FGFR3; this is already the case's top data-retrieval item.
If altered, contact the Lilly trials line about cohort B7 at MSK or NYU.
If FGFR3 is altered, also weigh approved-erdafitinib off-label logic against this trial with the treating team.
notes: Erdafitinib itself is FDA-approved for FGFR3-altered mUC post-chemotherapy; if FGFR3 comes back positive, that on-label option should be screened by the trial_screener as a follow-up, since it is not in the current dossier.
